_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Religion extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. sectarian_escalation) + active diagnosis ids (e.g. SECTARIAN_CONFLICT) (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). This table bridges the pulse-engine CONDITION vocabulary to the activations reachable through the real evidence-contract -> issue-circuit chain. As in Finance, Religion activation.diagnosticTriggers ARE diagnosis ids, so active diagnosis ids self-match; the condition-codes section is the part that is strictly required.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(religion-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L133-162)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L43-89 / L171-177)--> diagnosis id --(religion.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are themselves diagnosis ids)--> diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data). The condition-codes section adds the pulse-engine family hop.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate: requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, hasRequiredEvidence loop L171-174 — NOT primaryIndicators). A condition that is only a diagnosis primaryIndicator/secondaryConfirmation but does not emit that diagnosis requiredFamily is listed under secondaryDiagnoses and NOT folded (bias against over-marking).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from religion.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29). Derived deterministically and cross-checked against energy-neuro-substrate.js / energy-connectivity-audit.js style read-only execution of the sources.
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinanceEnergy: DIFFERENT structure. (1) SHARED-FAMILY CROSS-LINK: governance_event is a requiredFamily of BOTH INSTITUTIONAL_ABUSE ([scandal_event, governance_event]) AND THEOLOGICAL_SCHISM ([schism_event, governance_event]). So abuse condition-codes (which emit scandal_event+governance_event) fold into THEOLOGICAL_SCHISM too, and schism condition-codes (schism_event+governance_event) fold into INSTITUTIONAL_ABUSE too — a BIDIRECTIONAL cross-link Finance did not have at the requiredFamily level. (2) SHARED PRIMARY INDICATOR: identity_hardening is a primaryIndicator of BOTH SECTARIAN_CONFLICT and RADICALIZATION, but it classifies only to conflict_event/persecution_event, so it folds to SECTARIAN_CONFLICT and is secondary-not-folded for RADICALIZATION. (3) TWO DEAD-END FAMILIES: structural_event (from religion_high_stress/structural_stress) AND macro_event (from macro_shock) reach no contract requiredFamily (Finance had one dead-end, macro_event). (4) ORPHAN COUNT: Religion 10 (Energy 1, Finance 3), and 5 of them reference PHANTOM diagnosis ids that have no issues[] entry and no evidence contract, so they can NEVER be marked active — a stronger orphan than Finance's. (5) NO extinction-exempt empty-trigger activations exist in Religion (Finance had 4); every religion.json activation carries diagnosticTriggers. (6) Like Finance and unlike Energy, activation.diagnosticTriggers ARE diagnosis ids (self-match), not free-text phrases.
